limits: No robot ran. Each world only passed the validator, so whether the robot survives it is unknown.
Physics is hand-built and not validated against real hardware. Any result from these worlds is simulated.

The controller knows nothing about scene elements, so it drives into them and most of these worlds are expected to fail. That is known in advance and is not a finding. Worlds with elements are labelled and stay out of headline numbers.
